<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Single phase. Two independent pieces of work that share one gate: (a) flip harness telemetry capture to off-by-default without touching the read path, and (b) build the git-ai collector lifecycle in doctor — pinned download-and-verify, hook installation on our terms, and a health ladder that proves collection from an observed checkpoint rather than daemon liveness.
